news.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
news.summary: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

news.title: OKXICE to debut tokenized stock trading with Strategy, Coinbase, Circle this month
